title: System settings
subtitle: Tune platform-wide limits and configuration. Changes take effect immediately.

max_classes_per_teacher.label: Max classes per teacher
max_classes_per_teacher.description: Maximum classes a teacher may own. 0 = unlimited.

max_questions_per_teacher.label: Max questions per teacher
max_questions_per_teacher.description: Maximum questions a teacher may own. 0 = unlimited.

max_exams_per_teacher.label: Max exams per teacher
max_exams_per_teacher.description: Maximum exams a teacher may own. 0 = unlimited.

max_students_per_class.label: Max students per class
max_students_per_class.description: Maximum approved students per class. 0 = unlimited.

max_attempts_per_assignment.label: Max attempts per assignment
max_attempts_per_assignment.description: Global ceiling on attempts per assignment. 0 = unlimited.

invite_code_length.label: Invite code length
invite_code_length.description: Length of generated class invite codes (6–12).

refresh_token_ttl_days.label: Refresh token lifetime (days)
refresh_token_ttl_days.description: How long a sign-in session stays valid before re-login.

reset_password_token_ttl_minutes.label: Reset code lifetime (minutes)
reset_password_token_ttl_minutes.description: How long a password-reset code remains valid.

assignment_due_soon_hours.label: Due-soon reminder (hours)
assignment_due_soon_hours.description: Hours before the deadline to remind students who haven't submitted.

notification_cleanup_days.label: Notification retention (days)
notification_cleanup_days.description: Delete archived notifications older than this many days.

max_reports_per_day.label: Max reports per day
max_reports_per_day.description: Maximum reports a single user may submit per day.

app_name.label: Application name
app_name.description: The brand name shown across the app.

maintenance_mode.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance_mode.description: When on, non-admins can read but cannot make changes.
